Set \(s=x+y\), \(p=xy\). Since \(x,y\ge \frac12\), for fixed \(s\ge 1\),
\[
p\in\left[\frac{s}{2}-\frac14,\frac{s^2}{4}\right].
\]
Correct substitution gives
\[
f=s^3-3s^2+3s+p(3-2s).
\]
For fixed \(s\), \(f\) is linear in \(p\), with coefficient \(3-2s\).

- If \(1\le s\le \frac32\), coefficient is nonnegative, so minimize at \(p=\frac{s}{2}-\frac14\):
\[
f=s^3-4s^2+5s-\frac34,
\]
which is decreasing on \([1,\frac32]\), minimum at \(s=\frac32\):
\[
f=\frac98.
\]

- If \(s\ge \frac32\), coefficient is nonpositive, so minimize at \(p=\frac{s^2}{4}\):
\[
f=\frac12s^3-\frac94s^2+3s.
\]
Its derivative is \(\frac32(s-1)(s-2)\), so minimum occurs at \(s=2\):
\[
f=1.
\]

Therefore the global minimum is
\[
\boxed{1}.
\]
